= Native STEM equations
:doctype: article
:stem: latexmath
:stem-renderer: native

== Inline equations

A fraction stem:[\frac{a}{b}] and a root latexmath:[\sqrt{x^2+y^2}].
AsciiMath can be mixed in: asciimath:[sqrt(x^2+y^2)].
Greek letters stem:[\alpha + \beta = \gamma].

== Display equations

[stem]
++++
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
++++

[latexmath]
++++
\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}
++++

[latexmath]
++++
\begin{pmatrix}a & b \\ c & d\end{pmatrix}
++++

[latexmath]
++++
\begin{aligned}a &= b+c \\ d &= e-f\end{aligned}
++++

++++

++++

[asciimath]
++++
sum_(i=1)^n i = (n(n+1))/2
++++
